target: 100% finite-content completion on the chosen PSP route, spoiler-free

areas.name: PSP Route and Save Safety
areas.location_cue: The title screen, difficulty menu, save list, and PPSSPP memory-card folder before starting.
areas.note: The PSP release is the definitive route selected in games.json.

save_backup.title: Create the master backup before play
save_backup.why: Missable flags begin early and later systems branch repeatedly.
save_backup.detail: Retain external copies, not only in-game slots.

levels.1: The chosen route uses the enhanced portable edition.
levels.2: Play the PSP release on hardware or PPSSPP with one clean memory-card set.
levels.3: Keep the PSP game unmodified apart from display scaling, record the region and build, and archive the complete save directory before changing emulator versions. Increased internal resolution is allowed; gameplay cheats are not part of the completion record.

levels.1: The highest built-in setting provides the route's full combat test.
levels.2: Begin or switch a protected PSP branch to Hard and finish that file.
levels.3: Use the same finite-content route plan on Hard, preserve the cleared system data, and record the difficulty screen with the final save. No additional reward is assumed; this row documents the available challenge mode itself.

levels.1: The earlier Japanese release is not the selected completion route.
levels.2: Treat the 1999 PlayStation version as historical comparison only.
levels.3: Do not merge original-release balance, interface, or localization differences into the PSP checklist. Start a separate archival file only if you intentionally decide to compare editions later.

items.label: Create a Rotating PSP Save Archive

levels.1: Dialogue, timed areas, rumors, and rare mutations create one-way completion gates.
levels.2: Keep branches before each personal-choice scene, timed dungeon exit, rumor spread, and late temple sequence.
levels.3: Maintain at least eight named save branches plus an external copy of the PPSSPP memory-card directory. Label copies by physical place, and never overwrite the only file before a rumor, gallery, Persona, or weapon result is confirmed.

areas.name: Personal Choice and Gallery Gates
areas.location_cue: The secret lounge, outdoor concert stage, museum catwalk anteroom, mountain path, and Gallery menu.
areas.note: Branch the museum choice because its two movies conflict on a single pass through the scene.

save_backup.title: Back up before each companion choice
save_backup.why: Helping at the wrong moment can close a prime Persona, while the museum has two gallery results.
save_backup.detail: Keep both museum branches until the Gallery and Persona rewards are verified.

point_of_no_return.title: Each scene locks its personal flag
point_of_no_return.why: The relevant answer cannot be changed after leaving the scene.
point_of_no_return.detail: Do not proceed without a pre-choice save.

levels.1: Let the affected companion handle the immediate problem without intervention.
levels.2: At Club Zodiac secret lounge, choose “Wait and see what happens.”
levels.3: Save before the scene at Club Zodiac secret lounge, select “Wait and see what happens,” and keep the resulting flag through the later reward check. Confirm Rhadamanthus Prime becomes available before deleting the pre-choice branch.

levels.3: Save before the scene at Outdoor Concert Hall stage, select “Let's wait and see what happens,” and keep the resulting flag through the later reward check. Confirm Eros Prime becomes available before deleting the pre-choice branch.

levels.1: Let the affected companion handle the immediate problem without intervention.

levels.3: Save before the scene at Mt. Katatsumuri choice, select “You'd deny his last request?,” and keep the resulting flag through the later reward check. Confirm Durga becomes available before deleting the pre-choice branch.

levels.1: Let the affected companion handle the immediate problem without intervention.

levels.3: Save before the scene at all three prime flags, select “preserve every success,” and keep the resulting flag through the later reward check. Confirm Vulcanus Prime becomes available before deleting the pre-choice branch.

levels.1: One version of the museum choice unlocks a character-specific movie.

areas.name: Mt. Iwato and Temple Upgrades
areas.location_cue: Mt. Iwato's B1F side passages and Reflecting Pool, followed by the elemental temple interiors and Velvet Room.
areas.note: The four masks, one equipped-Persona battle, and three temple pairings cover every ultimate form.

save_backup.title: Back up before the Reflecting Pool and each temple
save_backup.why: Missing a mask or using the wrong Persona closes a unique upgrade.
save_backup.detail: Verify the inventory and equipment screen before advancing.

point_of_no_return.title: The Reflecting Pool closes mask collection
point_of_no_return.why: Uncollected colored masks cannot be recovered later on that file.

levels.1: One of Mt. Iwato's side rooms contains a colored mask needed later.
levels.2: Search Mt. Iwato's secret rooms for Pink Azaz Mask before entering the Reflecting Pool.
levels.3: Explore every B1F branch, enter the concealed room on that route, and take Pink Azaz Mask from its item box. Confirm it remains in the key-item inventory; leaving for the Reflecting Pool without it permanently closes one character's ultimate upgrade on that file.

areas.name: Velvet Room Mutation Forms
areas.location_cue: Ordinary encounter floors, battle result screens, and the Velvet Room's Mutate Persona menu.
areas.note: Twelve minor-arcana forms require random mutation branches.

save_backup.title: Save before accepting every mutation
save_backup.why: The offered result is random and consumes the prior form.
save_backup.detail: Reload until the named target appears.

levels.1: This minor-arcana Persona appears through a random mutation rather than normal summoning.
levels.2: Use Pixie in a battle-ending Fusion Spell until its mutation offers Budai.
levels.3: Raise Pixie, save outside battle, and repeatedly finish encounters with a Fusion Spell involving it. When a mutation triggers, visit the Velvet Room and accept only the Budai result; reload if the random branch produces a different form.

areas.name: Climax Theater
areas.location_cue: The city-map theater lobby, ticket menu, membership display, and the three localized quest interiors.
areas.note: The localized PSP route has three built-in quests and no in-quest saving.

save_backup.title: Save before every theater ticket
save_backup.why: The quest instance disables normal saving and awards no points if abandoned.
save_backup.detail: Prepare equipment and healing before entry.

levels.1: The PSP-exclusive theater contains a finite side scenario behind a paid ticket.
levels.2: Buy School of the Heart (Part 1) for 10,000 yen at the Climax Theater.
levels.3: Prepare and save in the main game before buying the 10,000-yen ticket, because saving is disabled inside the quest. Finish School of the Heart (Part 1) without abandoning it, confirm membership points are awarded, and return to the theater menu.

levels.1: The PSP-exclusive theater contains a finite side scenario behind a paid ticket.
levels.2: Buy School of the Heart (Part 2) for 10,000 yen at the Climax Theater.
levels.3: Prepare and save in the main game before buying the 10,000-yen ticket, because saving is disabled inside the quest. Finish School of the Heart (Part 2) without abandoning it, confirm membership points are awarded, and return to the theater menu.

levels.1: The PSP-exclusive theater contains a finite side scenario behind a paid ticket.
levels.2: Buy Persona Thief for 10,000 yen at the Climax Theater.
levels.3: Prepare and save in the main game before buying the 10,000-yen ticket, because saving is disabled inside the quest. Finish Persona Thief without abandoning it, confirm membership points are awarded, and return to the theater menu.

levels.1: Repeated clears increase membership rank even after the three unique quests are done.
levels.2: Replay any completed theater quest until the receptionist's final rank dialogue appears.
levels.3: After clearing all three unique quests, repeat the fastest safe quest and never use Abandon. Check the receptionist after each points award; stop when her dialogue no longer advances, since rank changes conversation but does not unlock another localized quest.

levels.1: The Japanese edition had downloadable and custom-quest functions absent from localized releases.
levels.2: Do not present unavailable regional files as routine PSP completion.
levels.3: NEEDS_VERIFICATION

save_backup.title: Back up before spreading weapon rumors

save_backup.detail: Archive every form, then finish on true power.

areas.name: Fusion Spell Registry
areas.location_cue: Party command order, Persona skill lists, battle animations, and the recorded Fusion Spell menu.
areas.note: Perform every finite PSP combination once so it becomes available from the menu.

levels.1: Arrange compatible Persona skills in the correct turn order to reveal this combination.
levels.3: Set slot 1 to Any fire spell. Set slot 2 to Any fire spell. Execute the ordered actions in one turn, let Blazing Burst activate, then confirm it appears in the Fusion Spell list before ending the session.
